title: What LiteFS Engine Is All About
description: Fly.io's distributed SQLite: FUSE replication for edge SQLite.. This database covers LiteFS Engine with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Every database engine makes the same fundamental tradeoffs between read speed, write speed, and space amplification.
definition: LiteFS Engine — Fly.io's distributed SQLite: FUSE replication for edge SQLite.
key_points: Every database engine makes the same fundamental tradeoffs between read speed, write speed, and space amplification.
The storage engine determines the ceiling; the SQL layer determines the ergonomics.
MVCC lets readers proceed without blocking writers, which is why modern OLTP scales.
Write-ahead logging is non-negotiable for durability; every serious engine has one.
